title: Iterated Sum Update
statement: For every $a,i\in\mathbb N$ and bit string $w$, applying the sum update $i$ times to the pairing of the binary representation of $a$ with $w$ yields the pairing of the binary representation of $a+\sum_{j=0}^{i-1}\mathrm{val}(\pi_1(\pi_2^{[j]}(w)))$ with $\pi_2^{[i]}(w)$. Here $\pi_1$ and $\pi_2$ are the total projections from the pair parser, and the exponent denotes iteration of a function.
